Full Day Hours on Weekly Off / Holiday
fields.description: Minimum hours worked on a Weekly Off or Holiday to count as a full day. Below this it counts as a half day. Used for PWO / PAW and HP / HP-A reporting and Compensatory Off. Default 6.

fields.label: Enable Comp Off Earning
fields.description: If enabled, employees earn Compensatory Off balance for qualifying attendance codes (e.g. working on Weekly Off or Holiday).

fields.label: Auto Credit Comp Off on Attendance Submit/Update
fields.description: Automatically process and credit/reverse Comp Off when Attendance is submitted, updated, or cancelled.

fields.label: Comp Off Leave Type
fields.description: Leave Type credited when Comp Off is earned. Mandatory when Comp Off Earning is enabled.

fields.label: Comp Off Rules
fields.description: Mapping from Attendance Code to Comp Off days earned.
